description: Abstract class for processing asset profile updates in Thingsboard, including saving or updating asset profiles with validation and handling default rule chains and dashboards.

classes.name: BaseAssetProfileProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods to save or update asset profiles, including validation and setting default rule chains and dashboards.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateAssetProfile
methods.description: Handles creation or update of an AssetProfile, including validation, renaming if name conflicts, and setting default rule chains and dashboards.

methods.name: setDefaultRuleChainId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the default rule chain ID for an asset profile.

methods.name: setDefaultEdgeRuleChainId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the default edge rule chain ID for an asset profile.

methods.name: setDefaultDashboardId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the default dashboard ID for an asset profile.
